about_the_game:
Converse With a Small Person is a narrative experience that will take around 2 hours to complete. It mainly consists of a conversation between you and an old friend you never really knew. It's your choice to find meaning in it and if you do, it will adapt.

A Story Shaped By Conversations

Every choice you make influences what will happen, think of it as talking to an old friend you haven't seen in a while. If he was flat.

Dialogue, Dialogue, and more Dialogue

This game heavily relies on you, the player, paying attention to what the little guy says. You cannot skip the text, so pay attention!

Talk a little Deeper

Choose choices that you wouldn't otherwise and see what the little guy says. You might be surprised how much it resonates.

Immersive Environments Shaped by Your Dialogue

Whatever you choose to talk about, the environment will change into that area. Look around these environments but make sure to focus on the little guy.
